findings.body:
chunk 2/2:

Gain 4, Work 2, Harm 3
Raise: Gate. Case: normal use - a pull request changes the design renderer in `.forge/design/support.js` without changing a test that names it. The docs-only exclusions include all of `.forge/**`, although that directory contains executable scripts. The classifier can then report `docs-only=true`; the `tests` job is skipped, and `tests-passed` accepts that skip. A change to executable tooling can therefore receive a green required tests check without running tests.
findings.title: Gate: executable .forge changes can skip the test suite
